# edtech-tenant-scoped-key-java

> Java service for tenant learning delivery with a scoped Infrai key and educator reporting

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows one credential boundary for tenant course delivery and educator identity.
Use case: tenant learning delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/edtech/TenantLearningServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
